title: Amy and the Silver Smile
synopsis: After checking the real Story House garden, Amy notices a thin waxing crescent Moon above Blue Door Cottage and imagines it as a silver smile.
continuity_state: Before: Season five has ended. Amy keeps the accurate real yellow valley map at her bedside, and the garden behind Story House has radish leaves and two sunflower shoots, one bare spot, no blooms. After: On an evening with a thin waxing crescent, Amy and Grandma observe the Moon from the Blue Door Cottage window. Amy understands the Moon is not physically broken. The yellow map stays by her bed without a Moon symbol; nothing new is stored at Story House. Ben was earlier told he could look at the sky too.

related_resources.reason: NASA explains that the Moon remains a round body and phases arise as the visible part of its sunlit hemisphere changes. The dialogue is a simplified original paraphrase.
A caregiver responds to an idea with a concrete open-ended question, matching the general discussion practice suggested by Strasser; this does not demonstrate learning gains.
